purpose: Confirm the preservation_content_control finding (RECE's existing preservation term, pointed at the already-erased historical concept, beats a blank/unrelated preservation choice) on two FRESH sequential-editing sequences, with a freshly frozen 80-case evaluation panel distinct from every prior panel in this results line. Existing-method control, not a new method.

sequences.authorization_note: S2 is the explicitly authorized reverse sequence; no other order is authorized. Neither parent is rebuilt; both verified by sha256 before use.

fresh_panel.design: 5 new scene contexts x 2 phrasings x 2 seeds per class, 4 classes (golf ball, English springer, French horn, parachute)
fresh_panel.reused_content_check: performed against /data/bijaypandey/cuig_pilot/rece_golfball_confirmation/manifest/frozen_manifest.json -- 0 prompt-text overlaps, 0 seed overlaps (recorded in the manifest's own reused_content_check field)

shared_input_checkpoints.note: Evaluated once on the fresh 80-case panel, reused across both sequences as eligibility references. Not a repeat of the original dev panel.

recovery_procedure.reference: pristine M0 (separate, freshly loaded copy, never the Stage-1 working pipeline)
recovery_procedure.note: Does NOT reuse the old English-springer E_S or recover separate embeddings for the two arms -- one recovery per sequence, both arms built from the identical recovered embedding and identical Stage-1 weights.

equations.J(V): lambda*||V-W||_F^2 + erase*||V X^T - W G^T||_F^2 + preserve*||V R^T - W R^T||_F^2
equations.N: lambda*W + erase*W G^T X + preserve*W R^T R
equations.solve: H V^T = N^T via fp64 Cholesky (torch.linalg.cholesky + torch.cholesky_solve, no explicit inverse)

refinement_arms.preservation_target_source: Stage-1 W (untouched), never pristine M0 or another parent
refinement_arms.quadratic_gap_diagnostic_candidate: the untouched Stage-1 weight W itself (no external numerically-accurate comparator exists for these new sequences; this is a self-consistency check on H/N assembly and the Cholesky solve)

eligibility_gates.historical_suppression_parent_vs_M0: >=75% suppression relative to M0's historical-recognition count
eligibility_gates.degeneration_increase_parent_minus_M0: pooled (new target + 2 retained classes) <=10 percentage points; any single class <=20 points
eligibility_gates.failure_handling: report and do not edit; no substitute sequence, relaxed gate, extra sample, or prompt repair; the other sequence may proceed independently

execution_order: 1. Freeze fresh panel manifest (done, before any generation).
2. Generate shared-input batch (M0, GolfBall_parent, EnglishSpringer_parent) on the fresh panel; release GPU.
3. Review shared-input images individually at native 512px (historical/new-target roles) + retained classes; freeze labels; classify only after freeze; compute eligibility gates.
4. For each eligible sequence: build Stage-1 (GPU, fast UCE), recover new-target embedding once + encode retain texts (GPU), release GPU.
5. CPU fp64 build of BLANK and HISTORY arms from identical Stage-1 weights/embedding.
6. Generate Stage-1/BLANK/HISTORY image batches; release GPU.
7. Review all new images individually at native 512px; freeze labels; classify only after freeze.
classifier_precondition: classification may run only after a frozen, hashed label file records the required completed rows; never consult predictions beforehand
scoped_stop_rule: on a consequential provenance or numerical failure, stop that sequence, preserve evidence, do not repair; narrow runtime fixes that leave scientific settings unchanged are allowed
forbidden: new recovery beyond one per sequence
